title: Stability and Perfection in Constrained Weighted Network Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.06775v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a general framework of constrained weighted network formation in which agents allocate resources across coalitional interactions while facing feasibility constraints. More precisely, we allow arbitrary coalitions of agents to be assigned a continuous weight, and we incorporate both coalitional capacity constraints and individual budget constraints into the model. This framework extends the weighted network formation model of Bich and Morhaim by combining continuous interaction intensities with endogenous feasibility restrictions. Within this setting, we introduce a new notion of stability -- called coalitionwise stability -- extending pairwise stability to constrained network games. Under standard continuity and componentwise quasiconcavity assumptions on payoff functions, we establish the existence of coalitionwise stable networks. We then investigate refinements of stability inspired by the notion of perfect equilibrium

translated_title: 受约束加权网络博弈中的稳定性与完美性
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个受约束加权网络形成的一般框架，其中参与者在面临可行性约束的情况下，在各联盟互动之间分配资源。更准确地说，我们允许为参与者的任意联盟分配连续权重，并将联盟容量约束与个人预算约束同时纳入模型。该框架通过将连续互动强度与内生可行性限制相结合，扩展了 Bich 和 Morhaim 提出的加权网络形成模型。在此框架下，我们引入了一种新的稳定性概念——称为“联盟稳定性”，将成对稳定性扩展到受约束网络博弈中。在收益函数满足标准的连续性和逐分量拟凹性假设下，我们证明了联盟稳定网络的存在性。随后，我们受完美均衡概念的启发，进一步研究稳定性的精细化。
tldr: 该论文提出了受约束加权网络形成的一般框架，创造性地引入“联盟稳定性”这一新概念，并证明了在标准连续性和拟凹性假设下联盟稳定网络的存在性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a general framework for constrained weighted network formation, proposes a novel stability concept called "coalitionwise stability," and establishes the existence of coalitionwise stable networks under standard continuity and quasiconcavity assumptions.
